name: ddna
description: Connect ChatGPT or Codex to DDNA and do anything Project Chat can: requirements, Project Intent, the engineering model and bill of materials, change control, technical reviews, DFMEA, deliverables, tasks, gates, and stand-ups, using your own DDNA account and permissions.

interface.shortDescription: Work on your DDNA engineering projects.
interface.longDescription: Sign in with your DDNA account to work on requirements, Project Intent, the engineering model and bill of materials, change control, technical reviews, DFMEA, deliverables, and tasks. You choose which permissions to grant, and every action follows your DDNA workspace and project roles.
defaultPrompt: Review a DDNA requirement for testability.
Help shape my project's Intent documents.
Show my project's open Git tasks and gates.
